args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Clothing:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Hat with wide brim
- Sunglasses

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Water shoes

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking boots/shoes (for Diamond Head)
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Quick-dry t-shirts
- Small backpack/daypack
- Water bottle/hydration system
- Insect repellent

Electronics:
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Phone charger
- Portable power bank
- Universal travel adapter
- Waterproof camera (optional)

Health & Personal Care:
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid kit
- Motion sickness medication
- Hand sanitizer
- Toiletries
- Lip balm with SPF

Activities-Specific Items:
- Pearl Harbor: Respectful attire (covered shoulders, no shorts above knee)
- Luau: Optional Hawaiian shirt or dress
- Spa day: Nothing needed (provided by spa)
- Kayaking: Quick-dry clothing, waterproof bag for valuables

Miscellaneous:
- Reusable shopping bags (Hawaii has plastic bag ban)
- Travel guidebook/map
- Notebook and pen
- Snacks for travel days
- Laundry bag for wet/dirty clothes
